invariants.rationale: The method always returns a List; collectAsList never returns null.
The return type is explicitly a List and collectAsList returns a List type.
result is constructed directly from collectAsList on the stream returned by tagLocation, which has count equal to the size of the resulting list.
If the input dedupedRecords is empty, result will also be empty; if not, result may be non-empty.
Tagging does not increase the number of records; each result record corresponds to one or fewer input records.
